about: The epistola of the formulary “Queenship of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: From the mouth of the Most High I came forth, the firstborn before all creatures. In the highest heavens did I dwell, my throne on a pillar cloud. Over all the land, over every people and nation I held sway, and by my power I have trodden under my feet the hearts of all the high and low. He who obeys me will not be put to shame, and they who work by me shall not sin. They who explain me shall have life everlasting.
